title: NEB Class 11 Physics — Reflection At Curved Mirror — 2022
subject: physics
topicTitle: NEB Class 11 Physics — Reflection At Curved Mirror — 2022
source: NEB Grade 11 Model Questions / NEB Past Papers 2020-2024

questions.question: An object is placed 30 cm in front of a concave mirror of focal length 10 cm. Find the position and magnification of the image and state its nature.
questions.solution:
**Step 1 — Given:** $u = -30\ \text{cm},\ f = -10\ \text{cm}$

**Step 2 — Mirror formula:**
$$\frac{1}{v} + \frac{1}{u} = \frac{1}{f}$$
$$\frac{1}{v} + \frac{1}{-30} = \frac{1}{-10}$$
$$\frac{1}{v} = -\frac{1}{10} + \frac{1}{30} = \frac{-3 + 1}{30} = -\frac{2}{30} = -\frac{1}{15}$$

**Step 3 — Image position:**
$$v = \mathbf{-15\ \text{cm}}$$
The image is 15 cm **in front of** the mirror (on the same side as the object).

**Step 4 — Magnification:**
$$m = -\frac{v}{u} = -\frac{-15}{-30} = \mathbf{-0.5}$$

**Step 5 — Nature:** $v < 0$ → image is **real**; $m < 0$ → **inverted**; $|m| = 0.5 < 1$ → **diminished**.
(The object is beyond $2f = 20$ cm, so the image is between $f$ and $2f$. ✓)
questions.knowledgeNote: With a concave mirror, an object beyond twice the focal length gives a real, inverted, diminished image between f and 2f.
